projects.name: winCMPSCentroid (third-party copy of KDOT WinCPMS project list, published by a KDOT consultant)
projects.notes: NOT the official endpoint: a point (centroid) copy of KDOT's WinCPMS project extents hosted by a consultant's ArcGIS Online account (item modified 2026-07-01), no cost field. Planned = proj_status_cd 'PLAN' or d_proj_let_date in the future (179 records with let date after 2026-11-16); ifrt_fiscal_programmed_yr gives the programmed year. The official KDOT layer is https://kanplan.ksdot.gov/arcgis_web_adaptor/rest/services/Transportation/WinCPMS/MapServer/0 (polyline, listed on ArcGIS Online by KDOT) but kanplan.ksdot.gov did not resolve from the research machine, so it is UNVERIFIED.

parcels_statewide_note: No free statewide parcel layer with owner names was found for Kansas.

parcels_counties.notes: Unified Government of Wyandotte County/Kansas City KS. Owner name and site address only; no mailing address or value. STATE_ID is the state parcel id.
Published by the City of Lawrence GIS account; 41,800 parcels (appears to be county-wide or close to it; not confirmed). No value field.

parcels_counties_note: Not found or not reachable in the time allowed: Johnson (maps.jocogov.org answered 403), Sedgwick (gis.sedgwick.gov timed out), Shawnee (gis.snco.us timed out).
summary: Projects: only a consultant-hosted point copy of KDOT's WinCPMS project list could be verified (no cost); KDOT's own KanPlan server did not resolve from here. Parcels: no statewide owner layer; Wyandotte and Douglas verified, Johnson/Sedgwick/Shawnee not reachable.
